name: form
label: Application form
help_text: The HubSpot form applicants complete for jobs that apply by email. A workflow forwards the submission to the employer, so the employer's address is never published. Leave blank to fall back to the Contact Us CTA below.

default.message: Thanks - your application has been sent to the employer.

name: intro
label: Intro
default: Submit your application below and Weld Australia will pass it straight to the employer.

name: success_message
label: Success message
default: Thanks - your application has been sent to the employer. They will contact you directly.

name: fallback_text
label: Fallback text (no form selected)
default: This employer takes applications through Weld Australia. Send us your details and we will pass them straight on.

name: job_title
label: Job title (template override)
help_text: Set by the job detail template per HubDB row. Do not edit in the page editor.

name: job_reference
label: Job reference (template override)
help_text: Set by the job detail template per HubDB row. Do not edit in the page editor.

name: job_slug
label: Job slug (template override)
help_text: Routing key for the apply-forwarding workflow. Set by the job detail template.

name: employer_name
label: Employer name (template override)
help_text: Set by the job detail template per HubDB row. Do not edit in the page editor.

name: fallback_url
label: Fallback URL (template override)
help_text: Where to send applicants when no form is configured. Set by the job detail template.
